principle: E_reason receives verified facts collected before the historical cutoff, not narrative hindsight and not raw election outcomes.
explicitly_disallowed_features: journalistic adjectives without a factual proxy
real candidate, party, territory or election names
any fact learned only after the cutoff
missingness_policy: Every party-territory cell remains in the panel. Missing candidate evidence is encoded as MISSING and produces no automatic positive or negative residual. It is never a reason to drop a cell.
evidence_packet_rule: C1, C2 and H1 receive the identical machine-generated packet. C2 and H1 may not browse or request extra context.
source_evidence_rule: Each non-missing fact must point to at least one admissible evidence record with publication time, retrieval time, source class, content hash and archived excerpt.
